title: MCA Director KYC Regulatory Change Analysis
comparison_period: 2019 amendments with 2014 Rules as the underlying framework

sources.document: Companies (Appointment and Qualification of Directors) Rules, 2014
sources.limitation: The uploaded original text does not independently establish the previous Rule 12A deadline. The PDF also contains a later 2025 amendment.

sources.document: Companies (Appointment and Qualification of Directors) Amendment Rules, 2019
Companies (Registration Offices and Fees) Fourth Amendment Rules, 2019
sources.purpose: Fee schedule for DIR-3 KYC and DIR-3 KYC-WEB filings
sources.limitation: This notification amends the Registration Offices and Fees Rules, not Rule 12A directly.

sources.document: Companies (Appointment and Qualification of Directors) Fourth Amendment Rules, 2018
sources.purpose: Original insertion of Rule 12A (Director KYC) and initial 31 August 2018 proviso
sources.limitation: Relevant text reviewed from India Code source page; authoritative PDF could not be downloaded into this package. See docs/case_c_official_source_transcriptions.md.

sources.document: Companies (Appointment and Qualification of Directors) Third Amendment Rules, 2019
sources.purpose: Historical Rule 12A amendments: holder wording, 30 September deadline, DIR-3-KYC-WEB and related provisos
sources.limitation: Relevant text reviewed from India Code page and linked PDF text; original MCA PDF could not be downloaded into this package. See docs/case_c_official_source_transcriptions.md.

provisions.amended_wording: Every individual who has been allotted a DIN as on 31 March of a financial year shall submit e-form DIR-3-KYC on or before 30 April of the immediate next financial year; a special initial deadline of 31 August 2018 applied to individuals allotted DIN as at 31 March 2018.
provisions.change_summary: Rule 12A was inserted by the 2018 Fourth Amendment Rules; it introduced annual Director KYC filing and a special initial deadline.
provisions.limitation: Text reviewed from India Code source page; authoritative PDF file is not included yet.

provisions.baseline_wording: on or before 30th April of immediate next financial year
provisions.baseline_source: C2, page 2, wording quoted in the amendment
provisions.amended_wording: on or before 30th June of immediate next financial year
provisions.change_summary: The 2019 amendment substituted 30 June for 30 April as the Rule 12A filing deadline.

provisions.rule: Registration Offices and Fees Rules, 2014, Annexure item VII
provisions.amended_wording: Fee schedule specifies filing by 30 September for the immediately previous financial year, subject to the stated conditions, and a Rs. 5000 delayed fee.
provisions.change_summary: The Fourth Amendment substituted the fee schedule for DIR-3 KYC and DIR-3 KYC-WEB filings. Its 30 September fee-schedule wording must not be mistaken for a direct amendment of Rule 12A.

provisions.baseline_wording: who has been allotted; on or before 30th June of immediate next financial year
provisions.amended_wording: who holds; submit e-form DIR-3-KYC for the said financial year on or before 30th September of immediate next financial year; DIR-3-KYC-WEB permitted for qualifying subsequent-year compliance, with stated exceptions for mobile/email updates.
provisions.change_summary: The July 2019 Third Amendment changed the wording to DIN holders, moved the historical Rule 12A deadline from 30 June to 30 September, and added DIR-3-KYC-WEB-related provisions.
provisions.limitation: Historical amendment only; it does not establish current filing obligations. PDF download remains pending.

limitations: C1 does not independently verify the previous Rule 12A deadline.
C2 provides the previous wording in its amendment text.
C3 concerns fees and is a separate legal instrument.
The uploaded C1 PDF includes a 2025 amendment and is not solely an unamended 2014 text.
Historical amendment analysis does not by itself establish current compliance obligations.
C4 and C5 relevant text has been reviewed from India Code source pages; the official/source PDF files are not included in this package because automated downloads were blocked.
Do not treat C4/C5 text transcriptions as substitutes for official Gazette PDFs; retain REVIEW_REQUIRED until PDFs are downloaded and checked.
